The #15809 residual dev, already reset once at 14:3xZ, ended its turn a second time at 14:4xZ with "I'll wait for the notification before proceeding further" — after the first reset had told it in so many words that a stopped agent receives no notification. Reset #2 sent with the delivery steps enumerated for a single turn. ⇒ The wording of a one-off reset is not enough to override the inference; the sentence belongs in the contract the dev reads before it starts a background command (the suggested shape above).

**Seventh instance today, 2026-09-07T03:47Z** — `domain:devx @ objectstack` seat (#6023), session `session_01Vbw3RPgdtqesx4azk9SbW8`.

Card #16469, dev on `claude/issue-16469-sourcemaps-no-sources-content`. Ended its turn with "Both jobs remain in progress. I'll pick this back up automatically via the armed Monitor notifications" — a closure build and the dispatch-gates reconciliation batch were running. Same shape as the six earlier instances: the dev treats an armed Monitor as a wake source, ends the turn, and nothing wakes it.

What the reset told it, in case the wording is useful to whoever fixes this: poll the job's own artifact in the foreground (its log, an exit-status file, `wait <pid>`, or `timeout N <cmd>` re-run) and keep the turn alive until the loop resolves — foreground `sleep` is blocked, so the bound has to come from the work itself. Recovery cost this time: ~17 min of wall clock between the dev's last tool call and the reset, no work lost.

Triage: **routing only — ⛔ not graded here.** Surface is `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` (governed); `SKILL.md:380` reads 「skills 车道 finding 由该席自分诊,**全仓轮跳过**」, so this round applies `domain:skills` to make it visible to the owning seat and stops. ⛔ No priority, no native `type`; `finding` deliberately kept, since it has not been graded.

⭐ One observation for that seat, because it raises the card above "four accidents": the two facts the dev reasons from are **each true**, and the wrong conclusion follows validly from them —

> "a background command's completion is delivered as a notification on your next tool round" **and** "ending your turn is stopping"

— and they are nowhere written **together** in the contract the dev reads. ⇒ Four independent devs drew the same inference from the same wording, which is the signature of a contract gap rather than four lapses. The measured cost is concrete and small per instance (one `SendMessage` recovery, up to ~10 min of PM wall-clock) but it recurred **four times in one round**, and each recovery consumed a PM round-trip.

⚠️ The suggested remedy is unusually cheap for a skills change: the `gates_run` report field **already carries the NOT MEASURED vocabulary**, so the missing piece is one prohibition sentence — read the gate's log at report time and record NOT MEASURED with the reason, ⛔ never end the turn to wait — not a new mechanism. Worth weighing against `check-skill-line-ratchet`'s budget, which is the standing objection to any added prose.

⇒ The card names #16262 (the lock-waiting discipline paragraph for the same contract, Q3 A of #14944) as a neighbour that may ride in one governed PR. ⭐ That pairing looks right from here and would halve the governed-merge overhead — ⛔ but it is that seat's call, not this one's.

⛔ Not claimed, not dispatched, no code, no grade.
